name: Empty Crosses
source:
The story of Raymond Kilmont, a deacon in the town of Echo, his journey of the pain of a past and present that continues reflecting and the newfound future that shines in front of him. Raymond struggles with the trauma of what happened at the lake. A trauma so intense, it leaves him heartbroken and unable to move on and in need of love. Murdoch, burdened as the Byrnes’ only living son, also bears the scars of that day eight years ago. He also needs love in his life, an experience. The two are thrust together, bringing them close in ways they never thought possible before.

[From [url=https://hammeryeet.itch.io/empty-crosses]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
雷蒙德·基尔蒙特 (Raymond Kilmont) 是艾科 (Echo) 镇的一名执事，讲述了他不断反思过去和现在的痛苦以及在他面前闪耀的新未来的旅程。雷蒙德正在与湖边发生的事情所造成的创伤作斗争。如此严重的创伤让他心碎，无法继续前进，需要爱。默多克作为伯恩家族唯一在世的儿子，也背负着八年前那一天的伤痕。他的生活中也需要爱，一种经历。两人被推到一起，以他们以前从未想过的方式拉近了距离。

[来自[url=https://hammeryeet.itch.io/empty-crosses]Itch.io[/url]]
